summary: The implementation correctly addresses both requirements by adding `is_business_day` and `next_business_day` functions. The tests provided cover the core logic, including skipping weekends and holidays.
key_findings: `next_business_day` correctly initializes by advancing one day before checking.
The use of `set(holidays)` inside both new functions ensures efficient lookups.
The test case `test_next_business_day_skips_weekend_and_holiday` appears to test the intended logic (Fri -> skips Sat/Sun -> skips Mon holiday -> lands on Tue).
